figurative_meaning_en: Indicating extreme busyness or panic-induced commotion
similar_in_english: Running around like a headless chicken
example_sentences_in_bangla: হঠাৎ ঝড় উঠায় গ্রামে ছোটাছুটি পড়ে গেল।
অফিসে জরুরি কাজের খবরে সবাই ছোটাছুটি শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: A sudden storm caused a frantic scurrying in the village.
The news of urgent work led to everyone running around in the office.
note: This idiom vividly captures chaotic movement in Bengali colloquial speech.
